description: Isolability refinement chain of the symptom model authored for the UCI Robot Execution Failures data (pipeline/robot_failures/kb_spec.py). Level L1 is the task context, so modes of different learning problems are never confused; the structure that matters is inside each problem. The normal class of each problem is part of the hypothesis set (null_modes).

levels.label: Task context
levels.adds: which motion the robot was executing

levels.label: + load change
levels.adds: any deviation from the normal force/torque profile

levels.label: + force axis
levels.adds: task-frame axis of the force change

levels.label: + force sense
levels.adds: side the contact pushes from, or a lighter payload

levels.label: + moment pattern
levels.adds: contact on the tool or on the part, or a payload moment shift
